headline: IN-SPACe's Antariskh Ventures invests in Dhruva Space; TT&A, Xander Law advise
sum: Antariksh Venture Capital Fund had made a minority stake acquisition in Dhruva Space Private Limited for ₹60 crore. TT&A advised Antariksh Ventures on this transaction.
detail: Antariksh Venture Capital Fund had made a minority stake acquisition in Dhruva Space Private Limited for ₹60 crore. TT&A advised Antariksh Ventures on this transaction. The transaction team consisted of Deepa Christopher (Partner), Pratika Shankar (Partner), Aanchal Kabra (Associate) and Ruchi Tripathi (Company Secretary). Deepa Christopher, Pratika Shankar Xander Law Associates advised Dhruva Space on this transaction.
